title: Fails to autodiscover RSS feed despite rel=alternate header link (Nil Coalescing Blog)
summary: Heya, small bug report: the auto-add functionality fails on https://nilcoalescing.com/blog/ even though as far as I can tell they have a correct rel=”alternate” link in the header. I use the iOS client, where it just errors out saying no feed can be found; I just tried to reproduce on web and got a “Web Feed” but I think to understand that’s doing html analysis rather than just following an RSS feed. Cheers, Tikitu
body_markdown:
Heya, small bug report: the auto-add functionality fails on[https://nilcoalescing.com/blog/](https://nilcoalescing.com/blog/) even though as far as I can tell they have a correct rel=”alternate” link in the header. I use the iOS client, where it just errors out saying no feed can be found; I just tried to reproduce on web and got a “Web Feed” but I think to understand that’s doing html analysis rather than just following an RSS feed.


Cheers,


Tikitu
